meta.name: people-finder
meta.description: Translates an ICP and persona definition into a step-by-step guide for configuring lemlist's people database search to find the right contacts. Use when asked "find me contacts", "who do I search for in lemlist", "how do I find the right person to email", "build a contact list in lemlist", "search for [role] in lemlist", or after list-builder routes to contact-level targeting. Produces a pedagogical, step-by-step filter guide tailored to the ICP and persona.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据理想客户画像生成lemlist搜索指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在lemlist中按ICP精准搜索联系人
copy.tagline_en: Generate lemlist search guides from your ideal customer profile
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find the right contacts in lemlist based on your ICP

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供目标客户画像和角色，Claude 会生成一步步在 lemlist 中设置搜索过滤器的指南，包括职位、公司规模、行业、地点、资历及意图信号，并给出列表大小建议。
howto.when: 当你要求“帮我找联系人”、“在 lemlist 中搜索谁”、“建立联系人列表”等，或列表构建技能转向联系人定位时触发。

say.text: 帮我找SaaS行业VP级别销售的联系人。
say.note: Claude 会指导设置筛选条件。

say.text: 在 lemlist 中搜索刚换工作的人。
say.note: Claude 会建议使用意图信号。

say.text: 我需要构建一个面向中型企业的联系人列表。
say.note: Claude 会给出分步配置指南。

howto.what_en: When installed, after you provide an ICP and persona, Claude generates a step-by-step guide for configuring lemlist's people database filters, covering job title, company size, industry, geography, seniority, and intent signals, along with list size recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "find me contacts", "who do I search for in lemlist", "build a contact list in lemlist", etc., or after list-builder routes to contact-level targeting.

say_en.text: Find me VP Sales contacts in SaaS industry.
Search for people who recently changed jobs in lemlist.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using intent signals.

say_en.text: I need to build a contact list targeting mid-market companies.
